lines: Somewhere along the way, we started believing that *tired* means weak.
Even the best athletes have *rest* days.
And you're more important than your *phone.*
If you keep running on nothing, you won't get there *faster.*
Close the laptop. Put the phone *down.*
Sleep. Breathe. Do something that makes you feel *human* again.
No guilt. No checking emails in *bed.*
#Pause if you need to. Just don't *quit.*
end: Send this to someone who's running on empty.

post.title: Rest Is Not Quitting
post.caption: Even the strongest engine overheats. Pause if you need to — just don't quit. 🌙
post.first_comment: When was the last time you truly rested? 👇
